products.name: Canon EF to RF Adapter
products.tagline: Keep every EF lens you own on a mirrorless body.
products.description: The EF to RF mount adapter carries autofocus, stabilisation and aperture control from EF and EF-S glass to any EOS R body, with no loss of image quality. Weather-sealed and tripod-collar ready.

products.name: RGB LED Tube Light 30cm
products.tagline: A pocket tube of colour for backgrounds and rims.
products.description: A 30 cm RGB tube light with a built-in battery and magnets on the back. Dial in any colour or a white balance from tungsten to daylight, stick it to anything metal, and paint a background or rim a subject in seconds.
specs: Full RGB plus 2,500 K to 9,000 K white
up to 3 h at full power

products.name: Colbor CL60 COB Light
products.tagline: Sixty five watts of daylight from a light that fits in a bag.
products.description: The CL60 is the small COB light that keeps ending up on every shoot: bi-colour, accurate skin tones, Bowens-adaptable, and it runs off a laptop charger or an NP-F battery. Pair it with a 65 cm softbox and you have a key light for interviews and product work.
specs: Colbor mini mount, Bowens adapter included

products.name: Magic Arm + Super Clamp Kit
products.tagline: The two pieces that put a monitor, light or mic anywhere.
products.description: An 11-inch articulated arm with a super clamp on the end. Clamp it to a light stand, a desk or a cage and lock the arm with one lever. Every rig ends up needing two.

products.name: Zhiyun Smooth 5
products.tagline: The phone gimbal for people who film with a phone on purpose.
products.description: Smooth 5 holds the latest large phones with a case on, adds a fill light with magnetic filters, and has real controls: a focus wheel, a joystick and a mode switch you can work without looking. Runs a full day.
specs: Phones up to 300 g with case

products.name: Hollyland Lark M2 Combo
products.tagline: Two nine-gram microphones and nowhere to clip a cable.
products.description: Lark M2 is the wireless kit that disappears on camera. Each transmitter weighs nine grams and clips or magnets to a shirt, and the combo ships with both a camera receiver and a phone receiver, so one kit covers interviews, vlogs and phone-first content.
specs: up to 300 m line of sight

products.name: Godox S65T Softbox
products.tagline: A 65 cm octabox that opens like an umbrella.
products.description: The S65T sets up in seconds, folds down to the size of an umbrella and turns any Bowens light into a soft, flattering key. It ships with the inner and outer diffusers and a grid for controlling spill.
specs: Inner and outer diffusion, honeycomb grid

products.name: Viltrox DC-550 Monitor
products.tagline: A bright 5.5-inch field monitor that survives daylight.
products.description: The DC-550 puts a full-HD touch monitor on top of your rig with 3D LUTs, waveform, false colour and peaking, so what you see is what you shot. It mounts on any cold shoe and runs from an NP-F battery.

products.name: DJI Mic Mini 2 Combo
products.tagline: DJI's smallest wireless mic, in the full two-person kit.
products.description: Two transmitters, one receiver and a charging case: the Mic Mini combo is the set-and-forget audio kit for creators who shoot with a phone or a mirrorless body. Pairs directly with DJI cameras and phones, and the case keeps everything topped up between shoots.
specs: up to 48 h with the case

products.name: Feiyutech Scorp C2
products.tagline: Serious stabilisation without the serious price.
products.description: The SCORP-C2 gives a mirrorless or light cinema body three-axis stabilisation, a real handle you can hold underslung, and enough battery for a full shoot day. It is the gimbal we recommend first to anyone stepping up from a phone.

products.name: Zhiyun Crane M3
products.tagline: One gimbal for the phone, the action cam and the mirrorless.
products.description: Crane M3 is the compact all-rounder: light enough to carry all day, strong enough for a mirrorless body with a small prime, and it balances a phone or an action camera with the included mounts. The built-in fill light saves a trip back to the bag.

products.name: Feelworld F6 Plus V2 Monitor Kit
products.tagline: Six inches of touch monitoring, with the battery and arm in the box.
products.description: The F6 Plus V2 kit is the field monitor as a complete package: screen, tilt arm, sun hood and battery. Load your LUTs, expose with waveform and false colour, and stop guessing from the camera's own display.
specs: Monitor, tilt arm, sun hood, NP-F battery
ledgerNames: Monitor Feelworld F6 Plus V2 Kit

products.name: Feiyutech Scorp Mini 2 Kit
products.tagline: One stabiliser for every camera you own.
products.description: SCORP-Mini 2 swaps between a phone, an action camera and a light mirrorless body with the clamps in the kit. AI tracking follows a face without an app, and the touch screen keeps the phone free for framing.

products.name: DJI RS4 Mini Combo
products.tagline: DJI's compact gimbal with tracking in the combo kit.
products.description: The RS 4 Mini carries a mirrorless body with a mid-size zoom, balances in minutes with the Teflon-coated arms, and the combo adds the tracking module, the briefcase handle and the phone holder. Vertical shooting is a quick flip, not a rebuild.

products.name: Sony FX30 Cinema Camera
products.tagline: Sony's entry into Cinema Line, still in the box.
products.description: The FX30 is the compact cinema camera built around the same colour science as the FX3 and FX6: dual base ISO, S-Cinetone, 4K up to 120 fps and a body that mounts straight into a cage with 1/4-20 threads on every side.

products.name: Zhiyun Weebill 3
products.tagline: The mirrorless workhorse, with light and sound built in.
products.description: Weebill 3 carries a full mirrorless rig all day on one hand. The sling grip and wrist rest take the weight off your forearm, the built-in fill light and microphone mean fewer things to bolt on, and the app handles balancing, tracking and timelapse.
